verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak story layout. The headline is tiny and pushed to the upper-left, so it is dwarfed by the bottle. The cream circle is cropped in the bottom-left corner, the faded circle is cropped top-left, there is a lot of dead orange space, and the Try It button is small. A is worse because the NEW badge is stranded bottom-left below the CTA, away from the headline and product, which breaks reading order. In B the badge at least sits at the top, though it floats off any alignment axis.

Both have a tiny headline jammed near the left edge (x≈17), which looks undersized against the large bottle. Both also have a cropped cream circle bottom-left, a stray faded circle top-left, empty gaps and an undersized CTA. In B the NEW badge is orphaned at the bottom next to the cropped circle, after the CTA. A puts NEW at the top so the reading order works, but the badge is not aligned with the headline.

A is the original banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the story canvas, with over 80% of it empty orange. The bottle is a tiny thumbnail cut off at the left edge, the faded circle collides with it, and the text and buttons are small. It is unusable. B actually rearranges the layout around a large bottle, but it keeps the tiny left-edge headline, the NEW badge orphaned bottom-left after the CTA, and the cropped decorative circles.

B is a squashed copy of the banner in a middle strip: huge dead space top and bottom, a tiny bottle in a circle clipped at the left edge with a faded circle overlapping it, and small text. A at least makes the bottle the hero and stacks the content top to bottom. Its flaws are a tiny headline, a NEW badge floating unaligned at the top, a small Try It button, and the cream circle cropped bottom-left.
